model_annotation: The plot illustrates the informativeness of two methods, labeled "0-CoT" and "CoRe", evaluated across a sequence of numeric steps. The horizontal x-axis follows a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4 with regularly spaced tick marks at intervals of 1, lacking an explicit axis label or units. The vertical y-axis is labeled "Informativeness" and employs a linear scale ranging from 0.910 to 0.960 with major tick marks at intervals of 0.010. The plot contains two lines. The "0-CoT" method is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, demonstrating a steady decline across the x-axis; it starts at a value of approximately 0.959 at x=0, drops to roughly 0.952 at x=1, 0.934 at x=2, 0.919 at x=3, and ends at approximately 0.911 at x=4. The "CoRe" method is depicted as an orange solid line with upward-pointing triangular markers, which also exhibits a continuous declining trend across the plotted values. It begins at approximately 0.961 at x=0, decreases to roughly 0.949 at x=1, continues down to 0.934 at x=2 and 0.919 at x=3, and concludes at a final value of approximately 0.913 at x=4.
